name: White tail (Atlas titles on an all-white 747-8F)
description: All white, tail and engines too: no navy aft fuselage, no navy fin and no globe. The big 'ATLAS AIR' titles of the standard scheme over the forward fuselage. Seen on N864GT, a 747-8F that came to Atlas without its navy tail.

sources.title: N864GT (55066801910).jpg (CC BY-SA 4.0)
sources.note: 2026-01-19 at Los Angeles, from the left: all white with only 'Operated By ATLAS AIR INC.' small under the cockpit; white fin, engines and aft fuselage.

sources.title: N864GT (55066632078).jpg (CC BY-SA 4.0)
sources.note: The same day, climbing out: white fin and aft fuselage.

sources.title: Atlas Air Boeing 747-400 N322SG (the standard scheme)
sources.note: The 'ATLAS AIR' title as measured for the standard scheme (GTI/standard), reused here.

sources.title: N864GT on JetPhotos
sources.note: Evidence only: a later photo shows the big 'ATLAS AIR' titles added on the forward fuselage, the tail still white. Nothing measured from it.

titles.style: Heavy, slightly slanted capitals in navy, very large over the forward fuselage.

notes: The title is the standard scheme's, placed as measured there; that it's painted on N864GT rests on a spotter photo (evidence only), and its exact place on this airframe isn't measured. The belly isn't seen: drawn white, without the standard's belly title.
